properties.headline: Flood Advisory issued October 22 at 3:51PM PDT until October 22 at 5:00PM PDT by NWS Las Vegas NV
properties.description:
Showers and thunderstorms over the past 24 hours have resulted in
minor flooding and road closures around Panamint Springs. Continued
showers this afternoon may lead to additional flooding in flood prone
areas.

* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall continues.

* WHERE...South Central Inyo County in south central California...

* WHEN...Until 500 PM PDT.

* IMPACTS...Minor flooding in low-lying and poor drainage areas.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 351 PM PDT, Doppler radar indicated heavy rain due to
thunderstorms. Minor flooding is ongoing or expected to begin
shortly in the advisory area.
- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Panamint Springs and Darwin.
- Watch for flooded areas along CA 190 and Panamint Valley Rd.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Be aware of your surroundings and do not drive on flooded roads.

NWSheadline: FLOOD ADVISORY REMAINS IN EFFECT UNTIL 5 PM PDT THIS AFTERNOON
